warning_signs_missed: Day-3 sub collapse (60-70/day → 4) with no written recovery target — she later said 'I just need something to go viral soon'.
She asked twice (5/31, 6/2) about the paid promo Derrek pitched; it was never delivered or explained — the thing she was sold never showed up.

She was earning her own money on lives ($583 in two weeks) and immediately contested paying 35% on it — a client who believes she out-earns the agency on her own is a client testing whether she needs the agency.
Two 'all those leaks are still up' messages (6/26, 6/28), the second with no answer for 3 days.
Four payment-rail changes in five weeks; the last one (7/1) caused her bank to hold the wire — friction landed right before the exit.
The 7/6 exit message itself: no one replied within an hour, a day, or ever.
Post-exit templates kept firing (7/10), proving no one was reading the chat for signal.
top_fix: Give every new client one named account owner who posts a short written weekly number in the group (subs/day, revenue, what we did about traffic this week, what's next) from week 1 — and who is on the hook to answer any dispute or exit message within the hour with a call offer. Hannah left because she never saw evidence the 35% was buying growth, and when she said so, nobody was listening.
